$comment: GENERATED by `pnpm schemas:gen` from packages/schemas/{song,analysis,jobs,api,dsp}/**/*.schema.json. Do not edit.

All.title: All
All.description: The literal `"all"`, used where a scope may be everything (e.g. Region.tracks, key.transpose).

AnalysisApplyOp.title: AnalysisApplyOp
AnalysisApplyOp.description: `analysis.apply` (02 §4.2). System op: record one analysis stage's result and reconcile the document with it (02 §6). The op is order-independent: the document depends on the set of recorded stages, not their arrival order.

stage.description: The stage that finished. Each stage owns at most one effect kind; stages that change no arrangement carry an empty `effects` list (02 §6).

effects.description: The facts the document takes from the blob, in typed form. `bragi-model` cannot read blobs, so the producer projects them here (02 §6, Q12).

AnalysisBlobMap.title: AnalysisBlobMap
AnalysisBlobMap.description: Result blob per finished stage, e.g. rhythm → sha256:….

AnalysisEffect.title: AnalysisEffect
AnalysisEffect.description: One analysed fact the arrangement is built from. Each kind is owned by exactly one stage (02 §6).

AnalysisEffectList.title: AnalysisEffectList
AnalysisEffectList.description: The recorded effects, one per kind, in a fixed kind order (tempo, sections, separation, tags, description) so the list is a set rather than an arrival log (02 §6).

AnalysisRef.title: AnalysisRef
AnalysisRef.description: What the document knows about one source's analysis: stage statuses, refs to the result blobs and the projection of those results the arrangement is built from (02 §3.3, §6). The blobs' full shapes are in packages/schemas/analysis/.

effects.description: The effects `analysis.apply` has recorded, merged by kind. `bragi-model` rebuilds the analysis-owned arrangement from this list, which is why the document does not need to read the blobs (02 §6, Q12).

AnalysisRefMap.title: AnalysisRefMap
AnalysisRefMap.description: Per-source analysis results, keyed by SourceId (02 §3.1).

AnalysisStage.title: AnalysisStage
AnalysisStage.description: An analysis pipeline stage (04 §2, §3, §7; the `analysis.*` capabilities in 05 §4.1).

AnalysisStatusMap.title: AnalysisStatusMap
AnalysisStatusMap.description: Status per stage. Stages not yet requested are absent.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: The REST API error envelope: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }` (specs/05-backend-and-jobs.md §2). `code` is one of the stable codes in `packages/schemas/api/errors.json`.

Arrangement.title: Arrangement
Arrangement.description: Timebase, the ordered sections and the master bus (02 §3.5). Absolute section positions are derived, never stored.

sections.description: ORDERED. The absolute start tick of section i is the sum of lengthTicks of sections[0..i).

AssetHash.title: AssetHash
AssetHash.description: Content address of an asset or blob: `sha256:` + lowercase hex of the file bytes (02 §2.1).

AssetMeta.title: AssetMeta
AssetMeta.description: Metadata of a content-addressed asset. Stored in the DB and local cache, never in the document (02 §3.2).

AuthMode.title: AuthMode
AuthMode.description: `single-user` resolves every request to the owner; `multi-user` uses Better Auth (ADR-0014).

AuthModeAnonymous.title: AuthModeAnonymous
AuthModeAnonymous.description: No session: only possible in multi-user mode.

AuthModeResponse.title: AuthModeResponse
AuthModeResponse.description: `GET /v1/auth/mode`: which auth mode the API runs in, and the signed-in user if there is one (specs/05-backend-and-jobs.md §8, ADR-0014). In single-user mode `user` is always the owner.

AuthModeUserOrNull.title: AuthModeUserOrNull
AuthModeUserOrNull.description: The signed-in user, or null when signed out in multi-user mode.

Automation.title: Automation
Automation.description: A parameter curve (02 §3.7). Lane automation is section-relative, master automation uses absolute arrangement ticks.

AutomationClearOp.title: AutomationClearOp
AutomationClearOp.description: `automation.clear` (02 §4.2). Remove a target's points, optionally only within a range.

AutomationSetOp.title: AutomationSetOp
AutomationSetOp.description: `automation.set` (02 §4.2). Replace the points of a target within the tick range the given points span.

BeatTimes.title: BeatTimes
BeatTimes.description: Beat or downbeat onsets in seconds of the working asset.

BranchMap.title: BranchMap
BranchMap.description: Branch tips by user-chosen name, e.g. "Club version".

system.description: Generated by the system, not offered in the expert drawer.

masterOnly.description: Allowed only on the master chain.

CatalogNumberListParam.title: CatalogNumberListParam
CatalogNumberListParam.description: A multi-band list (match_eq.bands), not representable in FxParams.

CatalogParamSpec.title: CatalogParamSpec
CatalogParamSpec.description: A parameter's kind and, for numeric params, its range and default.

CatalogTrackIdParam.title: CatalogTrackIdParam
CatalogTrackIdParam.description: A routing target (sidechain_duck.sourceTrack), not a value in FxParams.

ChannelCount.title: ChannelCount
ChannelCount.description: Channel count of an asset or source: mono or stereo. Ingest duplicates mono and downmixes more than two channels (04 §3.1).

bass.description: Slash bass note, when it differs from the root.

startBeat.description: Beats relative to the start of the target span.

Clip.title: Clip
Clip.description: A window onto an asset, placed in a lane (02 §3.6). The clip's end tick is derived from its warp.

srcEnd.description: Samples into the asset; srcStart < srcEnd (invariant 4.3.2).

start.description: Ticks, relative to the section start.

ClipAddOp.title: ClipAddOp
ClipAddOp.description: `clip.add` (02 §4.2). Add a clip to a section's lane for a track.

ClipReplaceOp.title: ClipReplaceOp
ClipReplaceOp.description: `clip.replace` (02 §4.2). Replace one clip with N clips (AI results).

atTick.description: Ticks relative to the section start (the frame of clip.start).

ClipUpdateOp.title: ClipUpdateOp
ClipUpdateOp.description: `clip.update` (02 §4.2). Patch a clip: move, trim, gain, fades, pitch, warp.

Commit.title: Commit
Commit.description: A node in the version DAG: one op batch plus a full snapshot of the document after it (02 §7).

parents.description: Empty for the root commit, one parent otherwise. Never two in v1: there are no true merges (region.adopt instead).

snapshot.description: Uncompressed canonical JSON of the full document after this commit, content-addressed in the BlobCache (02 §7). zstd is a later optimisation (Q85).

candidateGroup.description: Candidates produced by one AI request share a group.

CommitId.title: CommitId
CommitId.description: Commit ID: `cmt_` + the first 26 chars of the base32 SHA-256 of the commit's canonical JSON (02 §2.1).

CurvePoint.title: CurvePoint
CurvePoint.description: A point on a section-relative curve: tick relative to the section start, value 0..1.

DescriptionResult.title: DescriptionResult
DescriptionResult.description: The `describe` stage result: the LLM-written, feature-grounded description (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §6.3).

summary.description: One paragraph, plain language, no jargon.

DrumComponent.title: DrumComponent
DrumComponent.description: A drum sub-stem produced by the deep `drum_split` stage (04 §7).

DrumSplitResult.title: DrumSplitResult
DrumSplitResult.description: The deep `drum_split` stage result: sub-stems of the drum stem (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §7).

EmbeddingResult.title: EmbeddingResult
EmbeddingResult.description: The result of `embed_full`, `section_embed` or `stem_embed`: pooled CLAP-family vectors (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §6.1). The exact windowing and vector layout are an open question for the embedding work package.

dim.description: Vector length; 512 for the v1 CLAP checkpoints (04 §6.1).

lowConfidence.description: True when the audio had too little energy or duration to embed meaningfully; the vectors are still published (04 §10).

scopeRef.description: Section id (for `scope: "section"`) or stem role (for `scope: "stem"`); absent for a song-level vector.

EnergyTarget.title: EnergyTarget
EnergyTarget.description: Optional user-drawn energy target from skyline editing.

message.description: Human-readable, safe to show. Never contains audio content, lyrics or prompts (05 §12).

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: The stable error codes, mirrored in `packages/schemas/api/errors.json` (05 §2). `pnpm schemas:gen` fails if the two lists drift.

ExtendDirection.title: ExtendDirection
ExtendDirection.description: `forward` continues the song at its end; `backward` generates an intro before its start (09 §4.2 step 5).

shiftSemitones.description: Semitones the key gate shifted the candidate by (0, +-1).

ExtendKeyRelation.title: ExtendKeyRelation
ExtendKeyRelation.description: How the candidate's detected key relates to the requested one (09 §6 step 3).

amount.description: Wet amount of the spectral match, 0..1.

ExtendMatchEqBands.title: ExtendMatchEqBands
ExtendMatchEqBands.description: One gain in dB per band of the `match_eq` fx (03 §8.2).

step.description: Gate name: sanity, tempo, key, beat_align, splice, match or final_seam.

skipped.description: True for a step after a short circuit.

reason.description: Why a gate failed, e.g. "silent" or "tempo error above the gate".

metrics.description: The gate's own numbers. Deliberately open: each gate owns its metric names (config/generation_gates.toml).

ExtendStepList.title: ExtendStepList
ExtendStepList.description: The seven gate verdicts of 09 §6, in order; short-circuited steps are skipped.

ExtendTier.title: ExtendTier
ExtendTier.description: Latency tier (09 §5): `preview` streams fast candidates, `hq` is the background re-render.

FreeformParams.title: FreeformParams
FreeformParams.description: Process- or capability-specific parameters; their shape is owned by the process. Explicitly open: any key is allowed, and a generator must keep whatever it is given (an object that silently dropped unknown keys would not round-trip).

FreqRange.title: FreqRange
FreqRange.description: [lowHz, highHz], for paint and spectral edits.

FxAddOp.title: FxAddOp
FxAddOp.description: `fx.add` (02 §4.2). Insert an effect into a track, clip or master chain.

index.description: Position in the chain; appended when absent.

FxCatalog.title: FxCatalog
FxCatalog.description: The DSP catalogue (03 §6): one source shared by the UI (control ranges), the planner (allowed params) and bragi-model::validate. The instance is crates/bragi-dsp/fx_catalog.json.

$comment.description: Free-form provenance note carried by the source file.

FxInstance.title: FxInstance
FxInstance.description: One effect in a chain (02 §3.7). Parameter ranges and defaults per type are in crates/bragi-dsp/fx_catalog.json (03 §6).

sidechainSource.description: The key track for `sidechain_duck` (03 §6 `sourceTrack`). Only valid on `sidechain_duck`.

FxRemoveOp.title: FxRemoveOp
FxRemoveOp.description: `fx.remove` (02 §4.2). Remove an effect from whichever chain holds it.

FxReorderOp.title: FxReorderOp
FxReorderOp.description: `fx.reorder` (02 §4.2). Move an effect within its chain.

FxType.title: FxType
FxType.description: match_eq is system-generated; limiter is master-only.

FxUpdateOp.title: FxUpdateOp
FxUpdateOp.description: `fx.update` (02 §4.2). Patch an effect's parameters and/or bypass.

sidechainSource.description: The key track for `sidechain_duck` (03 §6 `sourceTrack`); `null` clears it.

GenerateExtendParams.title: GenerateExtendParams
GenerateExtendParams.description: Params of `generate.extend` (specs/09-generation.md §4.2): continue the song forward, or generate an intro backward. The rendered context audio is the job's `inputs.assets.context`; the backend requests `bars + overlapBars` bars so the gate pass can splice inside the overlap.

bars.description: Bars of new audio, not counting the overlap.

overlapBars.description: Bars of rendered context the model may re-create for the splice search (09 §4.2 step 2).

prompt.description: Optional user prompt. The planner/API rewrites artist names into descriptors before this point (specs/10-fusion.md §7).

GenerateExtendResult.title: GenerateExtendResult
GenerateExtendResult.description: One `generate.extend` candidate's result blob (specs/09-generation.md §6): every gate's verdict, the metrics the eval dashboard tracks, and what placement needs. The candidate audio is the sibling asset in the same `JobOutputs` entry. The blob is uploaded as `blobs.candidate_<index>` and published with the candidate's asset on the streaming `partial` event (09 §5).

index.description: Candidate index within the job, in the order partials were published.

asset.description: The processed candidate audio (48 kHz, 24-bit FLAC).

seed.description: The seed the backend actually used, echoed for regeneration and HQ re-render.

passed.description: Every non-skipped gate passed. A rejected candidate can still be returned, with qualityWarning (09 §6).

qualityWarning.description: Set when no candidate passed: the UI shows "This one might not blend perfectly" (09 §6).

seamScore.description: 03 §8.2 seam score of the final render, lower is better. null when the gates could not score the candidate; JSON has no Infinity.

tempoError.description: Relative tempo error before warping, 0..1 (0 when it could not be measured).

spliceOffsetSamples.description: Where the processed audio starts relative to the context edge being extended: the context end for forward, the context start for backward. Negative means it starts inside the overlap (09 §6, 03 §8.2).

HarmonyResult.title: HarmonyResult
HarmonyResult.description: The `harmony` stage result: key, key changes, chords and per-section progressions (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.3).

lowConfidence.description: Set when the key/chord estimate is not trustworthy (silence, too short, ambiguous key): the UI keeps the harmony strip but marks it uncertain (04 §10).

channelsOriginal.description: Channel count before downmixing; mono is duplicated for the working asset and more than two channels are downmixed, so this may be larger than 2.

fingerprint.description: Chromaprint fingerprint, used only for duplicate detection in the user's own library (04 §3.1).

peakPyramid.description: Level-of-detail peak pyramid for the Universe thumbnails, present when the worker computed it.

IsoDate.title: IsoDate
IsoDate.description: A timestamp: RFC 3339 in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds (02 §2.2). Kept as a string so it round-trips byte for byte.

JobEvent.title: JobEvent
JobEvent.description: A worker's progress report on a job (specs/05-backend-and-jobs.md §4.2). Published on `events.job.<jobId>` and fanned out to the client over WebSocket.

pct.description: Progress in 0..1; at most two reports per second (05 §4.3).

JobOutputs.title: JobOutputs
JobOutputs.description: Content-addressed results by role or name.

JobPriority.title: JobPriority
JobPriority.description: "interactive" (the user is waiting) is polled before "background" (05 §4.1, §9).

JobRequest.title: JobRequest
JobRequest.description: A unit of work submitted to a worker capability (specs/05-backend-and-jobs.md §4.2). The API publishes it on the capability's NATS subject; workers pull, cache by idempotencyKey and report through JobEvent.

capability.description: One of the capabilities in 05 §4.1, e.g. "analysis.separation" or "generate.extend". Open vocabulary: new capabilities land in the API's catalogue first.

idempotencyKey.description: hash(capability, inputs, stageVersion); the result cache is keyed by it (05 §4.3).

attempt.description: Retry count, owned by the orchestrator (05 §4.3).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context header, propagated HTTP → NATS → worker spans (05 §11).

automation.description: Lane automation is relative to the section start.

LaneMap.title: LaneMap
LaneMap.description: Content per track, keyed by TrackId.

LoudnessEnergyResult.title: LoudnessEnergyResult
LoudnessEnergyResult.description: The `loudness_energy` stage result: EBU R128 loudness and the energy curve that feeds the skyline (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.5).

hopSec.description: Hop of both the short-term loudness and the energy curve; 0.5 s (04 §5.5).

lufsIntegrated.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness in LUFS.

energy.description: The song's own energy curve, normalised to 0..1 (04 §5.5).

absoluteEnergy.description: Library-wide comparable energy in 0..1, present once normalisation constants exist (04 §5.5).

LyricsResult.title: LyricsResult
LyricsResult.description: The deep `lyrics` stage result: transcribed and word-aligned lyrics (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §7, 05 §12). Shown to the user only; never logged or used for training.

MacroCatalog.title: MacroCatalog
MacroCatalog.description: The v1 macros (03 §6.1): named, plain-language controls that drive several fx parameters at once. The instance is crates/bragi-dsp/macros.json.

$comment.description: Free-form provenance note carried by the source file.

MacroDefinition.title: MacroDefinition
MacroDefinition.description: One vibe slider: its identity, its two-word label and the parameters it drives.

label.description: The plain-language pair shown on the slider, e.g. "Dry ↔ Spacious".

MacroDrive.title: MacroDrive
MacroDrive.description: One fx parameter the macro drives. The curve's x values are the macro value and its y values are the parameter value.

param.description: A parameter name from the effect's catalogue entry.

curve.description: Piecewise-linear points, x strictly increasing from the macro range's min to its max and including x = 0 (the catalogue default).

mode.description: A fixed value for a discrete parameter of the same effect (e.g. filter mode 0 = low-pass).

MacroId.title: MacroId
MacroId.description: A macro ID: one of the built-in v1 macros (03 §6.1) or `mac_` + ULID for a custom macro (02 §2.1).

automation.description: Master automation uses ABSOLUTE arrangement ticks (02 §3.7, §5.3).

MusicalContext.title: MusicalContext
MusicalContext.description: The musical facts every generation request carries (09 §2.1). Context audio is a job input asset (inputs.assets.context), not a param, because it is content-addressed and streamed like any other input.

bpm.description: Tempo of the song the generated audio must continue.

chords.description: Chord symbols for the target span, relative to its start (09 §2.1).

energy.description: Target energy in 0..1; 0 is the quietest, 1 the loudest.

descriptors.description: Style descriptors from tags and the user's prompt. Never artist names (specs/10-fusion.md §7).

seed.description: Deterministic seed. Backends may derive one seed per candidate from it.

NamedAssetMap.title: NamedAssetMap
NamedAssetMap.description: Content-addressed inputs by role or name, e.g. { "mix": "sha256:…" }.

NumberSeries.title: NumberSeries
NumberSeries.description: A dense series of numbers, e.g. a per-hop energy curve or an embedding vector.

Op.title: Op
Op.description: One concrete edit operation (02 §4). Every op is an object whose `op` field names it; the rest is its payload (02 §4.2).

OpBatch.title: OpBatch
OpBatch.description: An atomic group of ops: it applies fully or not at all (02 §4.1).

intent.description: The user's words, e.g. "make the drums half-time".

label.description: Short human label for history: "Half-time drums (verse 2)".

PreviewResult.title: PreviewResult
PreviewResult.description: The `preview` stage result: the highest-energy 12 s window, encoded as Opus for hover-to-hear (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.7).

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A song document: the single source of truth for a project (specs/02-song-model.md §2, §3.1). Changed only through bragi-model ops.

ProjectId.title: ProjectId
ProjectId.description: Project ID: `prj_` + ULID (02 §2.1). The schema checks prefix and charset; ULID is the generation rule.

suggestedSections.description: Sections the analysis proposes but did not apply, because the user had already edited the arrangement (02 §6, Q13). The UI accepts or dismisses them; an empty list clears them.

ProjectSchemaVersion.title: ProjectSchemaVersion
ProjectSchemaVersion.description: Document schema version. Additive changes bump the minor version of the schema, removals and renames need `migrate` (02 §9).

ProjectSetMetaOp.title: ProjectSetMetaOp
ProjectSetMetaOp.description: `project.set_meta` (02 §4.2). Patch project metadata. Absent fields are unchanged.

suggestedSections.description: Replace the analysis section suggestions (02 §6, Q13). An empty list clears them.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a source or clip came from (02 §3.2).

Refs.title: Refs
Refs.description: Named pointers into a project's commit DAG (02 §7).

Region.title: Region
Region.description: The universal selection: what the lasso, paint brush and AI prompt target (02 §3.8).

RegionAdoptOp.title: RegionAdoptOp
RegionAdoptOp.description: `region.adopt` (02 §4.2). Copy a region's content from another commit (02 §5.4).

RegionClearOp.title: RegionClearOp
RegionClearOp.description: `region.clear` (02 §4.2). Remove or trim clip content in a region, adding short fades.

RhythmResult.title: RhythmResult
RhythmResult.description: The `rhythm` stage result: beats, downbeats, tempo and time signature (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.1).

bpm.description: Global tempo. Half/double-time ambiguity is resolved in favour of 70..180 BPM (04 §5.1).

alternativeBpm.description: The half/double-time alternative, when the tracker reported one.

isTempoStable.description: True when the BPM standard deviation is below 1%, so the map is treated as constant tempo (04 §5.1).

lowConfidence.description: Set when confidence is below 0.4: the UI enters free-time mode (04 §10).

SecRange.title: SecRange
SecRange.description: A half-open range [startSec, endSec) in seconds of the working asset.

SectionDuplicateOp.title: SectionDuplicateOp
SectionDuplicateOp.description: `section.duplicate` (02 §4.2). Deep-copy a section with new IDs and set derivedFrom (02 §5.1).

energySlope.description: Fitted slope across the section: positive rises, negative falls (04 §5.5).

SectionEnergyList.title: SectionEnergyList
SectionEnergyList.description: Per-section aggregates; `index` matches the structure stage.

SectionInstance.title: SectionInstance
SectionInstance.description: One section in the arrangement. Lane content is positioned RELATIVE to the section start (02 §3.5).

lengthTicks.description: Must be > 0, normally a whole number of bars.

derivedFrom.description: Set on duplicate, so the UI can show "copy of Chorus 1".

locked.description: AI-authored batches may not modify locked sections.

SectionKind.title: SectionKind
SectionKind.description: The musical function of a section (02 §3.5).

SectionMoveOp.title: SectionMoveOp
SectionMoveOp.description: `section.move` (02 §4.2). Move a section; its content moves with it (02 §5.1).

SectionProgressionList.title: SectionProgressionList
SectionProgressionList.description: Per-section derived progressions; `index` matches the structure stage's section index.

SectionRemoveOp.title: SectionRemoveOp
SectionRemoveOp.description: `section.remove` (02 §4.2). Remove a section; the gap closes.

SectionSetTransitionOp.title: SectionSetTransitionOp
SectionSetTransitionOp.description: `section.set_transition` (02 §4.2). Replace how a section is entered.

SectionSplitOp.title: SectionSplitOp
SectionSplitOp.description: `section.split` (02 §4.2). Split a section in two at a section-relative tick.

atTick.description: Ticks relative to the section start; 0 < atTick < lengthTicks.

SectionSuggestion.title: SectionSuggestion
SectionSuggestion.description: One analysed section that was not applied. `startSec`/`endSec` are the analysis truth; `startTick`/`endTick` are the same span on the arrangement's tick grid, for the canvas (02 §6).

SectionSummary.title: SectionSummary
SectionSummary.description: The compact per-section record used by the UI and the planner (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.6). A pipeline-side join of several stage blobs, not a stage result of its own.

SectionUpdateOp.title: SectionUpdateOp
SectionUpdateOp.description: `section.update` (02 §4.2). Patch a section's kind, label, energy target or lock.

SectionsEffect.title: SectionsEffect
SectionsEffect.description: `structure`: the analysed section boundaries and labels, exactly as the structure blob reports them (04 §5.2).

SeparationEffect.title: SeparationEffect
SeparationEffect.description: `separation`: one working asset per stem plus the residual (04 §4, 02 §3.4).

SeparationResult.title: SeparationResult
SeparationResult.description: The `separation` stage result: one working asset per stem plus the residual (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §4, 02 §3.4).

stems.description: Stems whose RMS stayed above −60 dBFS; silent stems are dropped so no empty ribbons appear (04 §4).

residual.description: working mix − Σ stems, computed by the worker (02 §3.4).

SidechainSourcePatch.title: SidechainSourcePatch
SidechainSourcePatch.description: A new sidechain source, or `null` to clear it (02 §4.2 `fx.update`).

Source.title: Source
Source.description: An original input: an upload, a generation, a recording or an imported stem (02 §3.2).

originalAsset.description: The exact bytes the user provided (or that were generated).

workingAsset.description: The 48 kHz 24-bit FLAC produced by ingest.

durationSamples.description: Length of the working asset in samples at 48 kHz.

label.description: E.g. the original filename, or "Generated: dreamy outro".

placement.description: Set when the source is placed by the user or a generation, not laid out by `analysis.apply`: the section whose lanes hold this source's audio (02 §3.2, §6).

SourceAddOp.title: SourceAddOp
SourceAddOp.description: `source.add` (02 §4.2). Add a source to the document. A generated source that is placed in the arrangement carries a `placement` naming the section its audio lives in; `analysis.apply` maps that source's stems into the section instead of building a baseline block for it (02 §6).

index.description: Position in sources; appended when absent.

SourcePlacement.title: SourcePlacement
SourcePlacement.description: Where a placed source lives in the arrangement. `analysis.apply` does not build a baseline block for such a source; it maps the source's stems into this section (02 §6).

active.description: Gate-open regions from a −45 dBFS gate with a 250 ms hop (04 §5.4).

presence.description: How present the stem is in each section, 0..1; `index` matches the structure stage.

StemActivityResult.title: StemActivityResult
StemActivityResult.description: The `stem_activity` stage result: where each stem is audible, and how present it is per section (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.4).

rmsDb.description: Whole-song gated RMS of the stem, in dBFS.

StemAssetList.title: StemAssetList
StemAssetList.description: At least one stem. Also the `separation` effect `analysis.apply` records (02 §6).

sections.description: Per-section aggregates, sharing the shape of the mix-level curve.

StemEnergyResult.title: StemEnergyResult
StemEnergyResult.description: The `energy_stems` stage result: the loudness-energy curve computed per stem once separation has finished (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §2, §5.5).

hopSec.description: Hop of the per-stem energy curves; 0.5 s (04 §5.5).

StemSectionEnergyList.title: StemSectionEnergyList
StemSectionEnergyList.description: Per-section aggregates, sharing the shape of the mix-level curve.

StructureResult.title: StructureResult
StructureResult.description: The `structure` stage result: section boundaries with functional labels (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §5.2). Drives the canvas sections and `analysis.apply` (02 §6).

lowConfidence.description: Set when the boundary model was unsure: the UI keeps sections but disables grid snapping (04 §10).

repeatGroup.description: Sections that share a group are repetitions of the same material (Chorus 1/2/3) (04 §5.2).

StructureSectionList.title: StructureSectionList
StructureSectionList.description: At least one section, ordered by time. Also the `sections` effect `analysis.apply` records (02 §6).

TagResult.title: TagResult
TagResult.description: The `tag` stage result: scored labels from the controlled taxonomy (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §6.2).

lowConfidence.description: True when the labels come from the untrained zero-shot fallback or the audio had too little energy to classify (04 §10).

TagScore.title: TagScore
TagScore.description: One taxonomy label with the model's score in 0..1 (04 §6.2). The label vocabulary lives in the tagging model's head, not in the schema.

TagsEffect.title: TagsEffect
TagsEffect.description: `tag`: the labels to merge into `meta.tags`, split the way the taxonomy reports them (04 §6.2). Scores stay in the blob.

TempoCurve.title: TempoCurve
TempoCurve.description: How tempo moves from this point to the next.

TempoEffect.title: TempoEffect
TempoEffect.description: `rhythm`: the beat grid as a tempo map and time signatures (02 §6).

TempoMap.title: TempoMap
TempoMap.description: Sorted by tick, first entry at tick 0 (02 §2.2, invariant 4.3.4).

TempoSetOp.title: TempoSetOp
TempoSetOp.description: `tempo.set` (02 §4.2). Replace the tempo map. Beatgrid-warped clips follow it.

TimeSigDenominator.title: TimeSigDenominator
TimeSigDenominator.description: Note value that gets the beat: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32.

TimeSignatureList.title: TimeSignatureList
TimeSignatureList.description: At least one time signature, ordered by bar; a bar keeps the last signature that starts at or before it (02 §2.2).

TimebasePpq.title: TimebasePpq
TimebasePpq.description: Pulses per quarter note. Fixed at 960 (02 §2.2).

Track.title: Track
Track.description: An instrument lane: a stem, a generated part or an fx track (02 §3.4).

hidden.description: E.g. the full_mix reference track after separation. Hidden tracks are still summed.

TrackAddOp.title: TrackAddOp
TrackAddOp.description: `track.add` (02 §4.2). Add a track, at index or appended.

index.description: Position in tracks; appended when absent.

TrackRemoveOp.title: TrackRemoveOp
TrackRemoveOp.description: `track.remove` (02 §4.2). Remove a track and its lanes.

TrackUpdateOp.title: TrackUpdateOp
TrackUpdateOp.description: `track.update` (02 §4.2). Patch a track's mixer and display fields.

TranscribeResult.title: TranscribeResult
TranscribeResult.description: The deep `transcribe` stage result: notes per stem from polyphonic transcription (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §7).

Transition.title: Transition
Transition.description: How playback enters this section from the previous one.

UserId.title: UserId
UserId.description: User ID. Opaque: the auth library (Better Auth, 05 §8) owns its format.

WarpBeatgrid.title: WarpBeatgrid
WarpBeatgrid.description: Follow the tempo map through anchors.
